entries.title: Proverbs 19:1
segments: ¶Better [is] the poor that walketh in his integrity, than [he that is] perverse in his lips, and is a fool.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:2
segments: ¶Also, [that] the soul [be] without knowledge, [it is] not good; and he that hasteth with [his] feet sinneth.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:3
segments: ¶The foolishness of man perverteth his way: and his heart fretteth against the LORD.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:4
segments: ¶Wealth maketh many friends; but the poor is separated from his neighbour.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:5
segments: ¶A false witness shall not be unpunished, and [he that] speaketh lies shall not escape. {unpunished: Heb. held innocent}

entries.title: Proverbs 19:6
segments: ¶Many will intreat the favour of the prince: and every man [is] a friend to him that giveth gifts. {him...: Heb. a man of gifts}

entries.title: Proverbs 19:7
segments: All the brethren of the poor do hate him: how much more do his friends go far from him? he pursueth [them with] words, [yet] they [are] wanting [to him].

words.text: him: how much more do his friends

entries.title: Proverbs 19:8
segments: ¶He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul: he that keepeth understanding shall find good. {wisdom: Heb. an heart}

entries.title: Proverbs 19:9
segments: ¶A false witness shall not be unpunished, and [he that] speaketh lies shall perish.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:10
segments: ¶Delight is not seemly for a fool; much less for a servant to have rule over princes.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:11
segments: ¶The discretion of a man deferreth his anger; and [it is] his glory to pass over a transgression. {discretion: or, prudence}

entries.title: Proverbs 19:12
segments: ¶The king's wrath [is] as the roaring of a lion; but his favour [is] as dew upon the grass.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:13
segments: ¶A foolish son [is] the calamity of his father: and the contentions of a wife [are] a continual dropping.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:14
segments: ¶House and riches [are] the inheritance of fathers: and a prudent wife [is] from the LORD.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:15
segments: ¶Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep; and an idle soul shall suffer hunger.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:16
segments: ¶He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his own soul; [but] he that despiseth his ways shall die.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:17
segments: ¶He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the LORD; and that which he hath given will he pay him again. {that which...: or, his deed}

words.text: ; and that which he hath given

entries.title: Proverbs 19:18
segments: ¶Chasten thy son while there is hope, and let not thy soul spare for his crying. {for...: or, to his destruction: or, to cause him to die}

words.text: . {for...: or, to his destruction: or, to cause him to die}

entries.title: Proverbs 19:19
segments: ¶A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment: for if thou deliver [him], yet thou must do it again. {do: Heb. add}

words.text: [him], yet thou must do it again

entries.title: Proverbs 19:20
segments: ¶Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:21
segments: ¶[There are] many devices in a man's heart; nevertheless the counsel of the LORD, that shall stand.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:22
segments: ¶The desire of a man [is] his kindness: and a poor man [is] better than a liar.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:23
segments: ¶The fear of the LORD [tendeth] to life: and [he that hath it] shall abide satisfied; he shall not be visited with evil.

words.text: : and [he that hath it] shall abide

entries.title: Proverbs 19:24
segments: ¶A slothful [man] hideth his hand in [his] bosom, and will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.

words.text: , and will not so much as bring

entries.title: Proverbs 19:25
segments: ¶Smite a scorner, and the simple will beware: and reprove one that hath understanding, [and] he will understand knowledge. {will beware: Heb. will be cunning}

entries.title: Proverbs 19:26
segments: ¶He that wasteth [his] father, [and] chaseth away [his] mother, [is] a son that causeth shame, and bringeth reproach.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:27
segments: ¶Cease, my son, to hear the instruction [that causeth] to err from the words of knowledge.

entries.title: Proverbs 19:28
segments: ¶An ungodly witness scorneth judgment: and the mouth of the wicked devoureth iniquity. {An...: Heb. A witness of Belial}

entries.title: Proverbs 19:29
segments: ¶Judgments are prepared for scorners, and stripes for the back of fools.
